range_digest_scope: returned bytes 0-1048575 only; not a full tile digest
extraction: Read bytes 0-1048575 (1 MiB maximum), close response; retain the first four values of the first four complete source rows unchanged; write ASCII with LF.
header_transformation: ncols=nrows=4; xllcorner=-90; yllcorner=0+(21600-4)*0.004166666667; retain source cellsize and NODATA_value.

intended_use: Offline loader regression comparators only; extracted information product, not measured survey data.
limitations: Route calculation fitness, survey adequacy, vertical-datum consistency and interpolation error are not established.
